title: Removal Cost Share Uplift, Optional Coverage Add-Ons Haul-Away
content:
A removal-share uplift is added to the haul-away limit for equipment replaced under an Optional Coverage Add-Ons rider, according to the documented removal cost as a share of the component's contracted replacement cost, both as shown on the request's coverage determination:

| Documented removal cost as a share of the contracted replacement cost | Removal-share uplift |
|---|---|
| More than 0.40 (40 percent) | USD 20.00 |
| More than 0.20 (20 percent), but no more than 0.40 | USD 10.00 |
| 0.20 or less | None |

## Boundary figures (hypothetical, contracted replacement cost USD 1,000.00)

| Documented removal cost | Share | Uplift |
|---|---|---|
| USD 401.00 | 0.401 | USD 20.00 |
| USD 400.00 | 0.40 | USD 10.00 |
| USD 201.00 | 0.201 | USD 10.00 |
| USD 200.00 | 0.20 | None |
